assembly_instructions: Machine four 6061 aluminum corner rails to a 100 mm CubeSat height and fasten them to the -Y bottom end cap at the four 6 mm square rail corners.
Install the +X, -X, +Z, and -Z lower cross rails between adjacent corner rails to square the 100 mm frame while leaving the side walls open.
Install the four PC/104 standoffs on the bottom end cap and bolt the vertical -Z backplane PCB to the rear interior standoff line.
Slide the battery, ADACS, OBC, and UHF communications PC/104 cards down the standoffs from bottom to top and plug each brass edge connector into the backplane.
Fit the battery cells, ADACS torque rods, OBC processor, radio module, and board-to-board spacers on their named PC/104 cards before closing the upper frame.
Fasten the four split +Y top cap perimeter bars to the corner rails and bolt the small top instrument island between them so the avionics stack remains visible in this cutaway model.
Bond the -Z body-mounted solar panel to the -Z face; mount the +Z body-mounted solar panel on two exploded service spacers aligned with the +Z outline rail so the internal stack remains visible.
Attach the +X and -X hinge rods and their hinge brackets to the top side rails, then pin the two deployable solar panels so each is shown deployed 90 degrees outward.
Install the burn-wire retainers at both hinges, route the UHF radio feed to the antenna base, and seat the whip antenna vertically on the top instrument island.
Install the CMOS camera lens through the exploded +Z solar face, place the sun sensor and magnetometer on the top island, and mount the deployment switch plunger on the -X -Z lower rail corner.

info.summary: Open-hardware 1U CubeSat from the Portland State Aerospace Society — a technology-demonstration precursor to the larger OreSat bus.
info.description: OreSat0 is an open-source 1U (10×10×10 cm) CubeSat developed by the Portland State Aerospace Society (PSAS). It was built to flight-qualify the structural, power, and command-and-data-handling systems of the larger OreSat bus before those subsystems flew on a 2U/3U science mission. Four 6061 aluminum corner rails carry the launch loads, closed off by machined +Y and -Y end-cap structure. This scene splits the +Y cap into perimeter bars and a small instrument island as a deliberate cutaway so the PC/104 avionics stack remains visible. Inside, a PC/104-form-factor stack holds a battery card, an ADACS module, an on-board computer, and a UHF comms card — all plugging into a shared backplane that runs power and CAN bus between them. Two deployable solar panels hinge outward from opposite side rails on burn-wire releases; the other two side faces carry flush body-mounted solar cells, with the +Z panel exploded outward in this view. External features include a CMOS camera lens in one side face, a sun sensor and magnetometer on the top face, a UHF whip antenna, and a deployment switch on one bottom corner that arms the satellite on release from the P-POD dispenser.
info.contractor: PSAS student/volunteer team, Portland State University
info.status: Flown (deorbited). Design iterated into OreSat (2U+) flight bus.

facts.label: Scene scale
facts.value: 1 scene metre equals 1 real metre; no scale reduction needed

facts.label: Frame rail section
facts.value: Four corner rails are modelled as 0.006 × 0.100 × 0.006 m members

facts.label: Split top cap
facts.value: The +Y cap is shown as four 0.006 m thick perimeter bars plus a 0.032 m square instrument island for cutaway legibility

facts.label: PC/104 cards
facts.value: Four internal cards are 0.082 × 0.004 × 0.070 m with 0.014 m vertical pitch

facts.label: Backplane
facts.value: Vertical backplane PCB is 0.082 × 0.075 × 0.004 m on the -Z interior wall

facts.label: Deployable solar panels
facts.value: Two side panels are 0.098 × 0.003 × 0.094 m and shown deployed 90 degrees

facts.label: Body solar panels
facts.value: -Z panel is flush; +Z panel is offset 0.045 m outward as an exploded service view

facts.label: Whip antenna
facts.value: UHF monopole is modelled as a 0.180 m long, 0.0015 m radius steel cylinder

facts.label: Mass class
facts.value: Approximately 1.0 kg for the OreSat0 1U demonstrator

parts.name: Bottom End Cap (-Y)
parts.role: Machined 6061 aluminum bottom plate that squares the four rails and receives the P-POD pusher load.

parts.name: Corner Rail (+X +Z)
parts.role: Forward-port corner rail that carries launch-guide contact loads along the full 100 mm CubeSat height.

parts.name: Corner Rail (+X -Z)
parts.role: Forward-starboard corner rail that fixes the +X deployable panel hinge line.

parts.name: Corner Rail (-X +Z)
parts.role: Rear-port corner rail that supports the exploded +Z solar panel service bracket.

parts.name: Corner Rail (-X -Z)
parts.role: Rear-starboard corner rail that carries the deployment switch bracket near the lower dispenser contact corner.

parts.name: Cutaway Top Cap Bar (+X)
parts.role: Front perimeter segment of the split top cap; it closes the rail corner while leaving the card stack visible.

parts.name: Cutaway Top Cap Bar (-X)
parts.role: Rear perimeter segment of the split top cap; it ties the rear rails without covering the avionics stack.

parts.name: Cutaway Top Cap Bar (+Z)
parts.role: Port perimeter segment of the top cap aligned with the exploded +Z wall opening.

parts.name: Cutaway Top Cap Bar (-Z)
parts.role: Starboard perimeter segment of the split top cap that supports the fixed -Z body solar face.

parts.name: Top Instrument Island
parts.role: Small remaining top-cap pad that carries the antenna feedthrough and sensors without hiding the internal PC/104 stack.

parts.name: Top Rail Screw (+X +Z)
parts.role: Visible cap screw head fastening the split top frame into the forward-port rail.

parts.name: Top Rail Screw (+X -Z)
parts.role: Visible cap screw head fastening the split top frame into the forward-starboard rail.

parts.name: Top Rail Screw (-X +Z)
parts.role: Visible cap screw head fastening the split top frame into the rear-port rail.

parts.name: Top Rail Screw (-X -Z)
parts.role: Visible cap screw head fastening the split top frame into the rear-starboard rail.

parts.name: Lower +X Cross Rail
parts.role: Lower front frame member that ties the two +X corner rails together without closing the side opening.

parts.name: Lower -X Cross Rail
parts.role: Lower rear frame member that ties the two -X corner rails together.

parts.name: Lower +Z Cross Rail
parts.role: Lower port frame member left exposed so the internal PC/104 stack can be seen from the +Z side.

parts.name: Lower -Z Cross Rail
parts.role: Lower starboard frame member that backs the fixed -Z body solar panel.

parts.name: Upper +X Cross Rail
parts.role: Upper front frame member that carries the +X hinge brackets.

parts.name: Upper -X Cross Rail
parts.role: Upper rear frame member that carries the -X hinge brackets.

parts.name: Upper +Z Cross Rail
parts.role: Upper port frame member that leaves the +Z wall open for X-ray visibility of the avionics stack.

parts.name: Upper -Z Cross Rail
parts.role: Upper starboard frame member that supports the fixed -Z solar panel and backplane side of the bus.

parts.name: +Z Body Panel Cutaway Outline
parts.role: Thin reference strip marking the original +Z wall plane from which the body solar panel is exploded outward.

parts.name: PC/104 Standoff (+X +Z)
parts.role: Threaded spacer post that clamps the four PC/104 boards at the forward-port mounting hole.

parts.name: PC/104 Standoff (+X -Z)
parts.role: Threaded spacer post that fixes the forward-starboard edge of the avionics stack.

parts.name: PC/104 Standoff (-X +Z)
parts.role: Threaded spacer post that holds the rear-port corners of the cards visible through the exploded +Z side.

parts.name: PC/104 Standoff (-X -Z)
parts.role: Threaded spacer post that clamps the rear-starboard PC/104 mounting holes next to the backplane.

parts.name: Vertical PC/104 Backplane PCB
parts.role: Vertical PCB on the -Z interior wall that distributes power and CAN signals to each stacked avionics card.

parts.name: Battery PC/104 Card
parts.role: Lowest PC/104 board that stores solar power in Li-ion cells and feeds the spacecraft power bus.

parts.name: Battery Card Backplane Connector
parts.role: Gold-plated board-edge connector that plugs the battery card into the vertical backplane.

parts.name: Li-ion Cell A
parts.role: Cylindrical Li-ion cell mounted on the battery board as one half of the smallsat energy store.

parts.name: Li-ion Cell B
parts.role: Second cylindrical Li-ion cell mounted parallel to cell A on the battery board.

parts.name: ADACS PC/104 Card
parts.role: Attitude determination and control board that reads sun and magnetic sensors and drives torque rods.

parts.name: ADACS Backplane Connector
parts.role: Board-edge connector that carries sensor and magnetorquer signals between the ADACS card and backplane.

parts.name: X-Axis Torque Rod
parts.role: Magnetorquer coil core aligned along X to exchange angular momentum with Earth's magnetic field.

parts.name: Z-Axis Torque Rod
parts.role: Magnetorquer coil core aligned along Z for coarse magnetic attitude control.

parts.name: On-Board Computer PC/104 Card
parts.role: Flight computer board that runs command, telemetry, and payload software for the OreSat0 bus.

parts.name: OBC Backplane Connector
parts.role: Board-edge connector that links the on-board computer to the shared backplane bus.

parts.name: OBC Processor Package
parts.role: Main integrated-circuit package on the OBC board, shown as the central computer component.

parts.name: UHF Communications PC/104 Card
parts.role: Top PC/104 radio board that drives the UHF monopole antenna through the top feedthrough.

parts.name: Comms Backplane Connector
parts.role: Board-edge connector that carries UHF radio power and data to the backplane.

parts.name: UHF Radio Module
parts.role: Shielded RF module on the communications card that produces the UHF downlink and uplink carrier.

parts.name: Body Solar Panel (-Z)
parts.role: Fixed -Z solar panel bonded flush to the side frame to charge the battery while preserving the CubeSat envelope.

parts.name: -Z Upper Solar Cell String
parts.role: Upper photovoltaic cell string on the fixed -Z body panel.

parts.name: -Z Lower Solar Cell String
parts.role: Lower photovoltaic cell string on the fixed -Z body panel.

parts.name: Exploded Body Solar Panel (+Z)
parts.role: The +Z body solar panel is offset outward as an exploded part so the internal backplane and PC/104 boards remain visible.

parts.name: +Z Exploded Panel Spacer A
parts.role: Temporary exploded-view spacer that shows the real mounting offset direction from the +Z frame.

parts.name: +Z Exploded Panel Spacer B
parts.role: Second exploded-view spacer that keeps the +Z body panel aligned with its original side face.

parts.name: +Z Upper Solar Cell String
parts.role: Upper photovoltaic cell string on the exploded +Z body panel.

parts.name: +Z Lower Solar Cell String
parts.role: Lower photovoltaic cell string on the exploded +Z body panel.

parts.name: CMOS Camera Barrel
parts.role: Short camera barrel protruding through the +Z solar panel for the OreSat0 technology-demonstration imager.

parts.name: CMOS Camera Lens Glass
parts.role: Visible glass lens at the end of the camera barrel.

parts.name: +X Deployable Panel Hinge Rod
parts.role: Steel hinge pin spanning the +X top edge and allowing the front solar panel to rotate outward.

parts.name: +X Hinge Bracket +Z
parts.role: Small hinge lug bolted to the +Z end of the +X upper cross rail.

parts.name: +X Hinge Bracket -Z
parts.role: Small hinge lug bolted to the -Z end of the +X upper cross rail.

parts.name: Deployed Solar Panel (+X)
parts.role: Front solar wing shown deployed 90 degrees outward from the +X face to expose its photovoltaic area.

parts.name: +X Deployed Panel Cell A
parts.role: Inner photovoltaic cell strip on the deployed +X solar wing.

parts.name: +X Deployed Panel Cell B
parts.role: Outer photovoltaic cell strip on the deployed +X solar wing.

parts.name: +X Burn-Wire Retainer
parts.role: Resistive burn-wire loop that releases the spring-loaded +X deployable panel after orbit insertion.

parts.name: -X Deployable Panel Hinge Rod
parts.role: Steel hinge pin spanning the -X top edge for the rear deployed solar panel.

parts.name: -X Hinge Bracket +Z
parts.role: Small hinge lug bolted to the +Z end of the -X upper cross rail.

parts.name: -X Hinge Bracket -Z
parts.role: Small hinge lug bolted to the -Z end of the -X upper cross rail.

parts.name: Deployed Solar Panel (-X)
parts.role: Rear solar wing shown deployed 90 degrees outward from the -X face.

parts.name: -X Deployed Panel Cell A
parts.role: Inner photovoltaic cell strip on the deployed -X solar wing.

parts.name: -X Deployed Panel Cell B
parts.role: Outer photovoltaic cell strip on the deployed -X solar wing.

parts.name: -X Burn-Wire Retainer
parts.role: Resistive burn-wire loop that releases the -X deployed solar panel.

parts.name: UHF Antenna Base
parts.role: Feedthrough and spring base that anchors the deployed UHF monopole to the top instrument island.

parts.name: UHF Whip Antenna
parts.role: Straight deployed monopole whip used for UHF communications after release from the dispenser.

parts.name: Coarse Sun Sensor
parts.role: Photodiode sun sensor on the top island that provides coarse attitude information to the ADACS card.

parts.name: Top Magnetometer
parts.role: Three-axis magnetic field sensor on the top island used by the ADACS board for coarse pointing.

parts.name: Deployment Switch Body
parts.role: Limit-switch housing fixed to the lower rear-starboard rail corner and pressed by the dispenser wall before ejection.

parts.name: Deployment Switch Plunger
parts.role: Spring plunger that pops out when the CubeSat leaves the P-POD and arms the spacecraft electronics.
